summary: Tested Vedic Numerology feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 13 backend pytest cases pass including sample Rahul Sharma (1990-05-15 -> mulank 6 Shukra / bhagyank 3 Guru / naamank 6 Shukra), 422 validation for bad date and empty name, 401 for unauthenticated AI reading, 403 for non-premium user, 200 with advice for premium admin, and regression on auth/panchang/festivals/nakshatras/readings. Frontend /numerology page renders form + 3 NumberCards with planet/traits/gemstone/mantra/lucky info; logged-out users see Login/Register CTAs; premium admin sees Generate AI Reading button and receives a ~2013-char Markdown Claude reading via /api/numerology/reading. Navbar Numerology link present between Nakshatras and Basic Reading.
critical_code_review_comments: numerology_reading endpoint re-parses DOB and re-validates name twice via _parse_dob inside compute_numerology path — minor, works fine.

Frontend Numerology.jsx only shows AI reading section AFTER calculate is clicked (nested inside result block). Acceptable per design since we need profile data to send to Claude, but non-premium users never see the upgrade CTA until they calculate first — consider surfacing pricing teaser earlier. Not blocking.

Naamank derivation string for empty name is graceful; full_name validation at the API (422) already prevents empty submissions, so the empty-case branch in NUMBER_PROFILE[naamank] lookup is defensive but unreachable — fine.
test_credentials: admin@vedic.com / admin123 (premium, admin). Created ephemeral TEST_basic_<uuid>@vedic.com for 403 gate test.
seed_data_creation: Registered one ephemeral basic-tier user per test module for 403 premium-gate verification. No cleanup performed but emails are prefixed TEST_basic_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Numerology is fully verified. /api/numerology public, /api/numerology/reading requires premium tier, uses Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent LLM key. Admin seeded as premium on startup. Test at /app/backend/tests/test_numerology.py can be rerun any time for regression. Frontend data-testids: numerology-form, numerology-name-input, numerology-dob-input, numerology-calculate-btn, numerology-result, numerology-card-mulank/bhagyank/naamank, numerology-reading-btn, numerology-advice, numerology-upgrade-btn, numerology-login-btn, numerology-register-btn, numerology-error.
